summary: Add customer_note column, backfill data, deploy new version, retire old version, then drop note column.
write_consistency: During expand both columns exist; old writes to note, new to customer_note. Backfill copies note to customer_note. After retire_old, old is stopped; contract safely drops note column with no concurrent old writes.
revision_notes: Root cause: original plan executed contract-001 (DROP COLUMN note) before retire_old-001, triggering the runner's retirement gate which requires the old app to be stopped before schema removal. Revised plan reorders stages to: expand → backfill → deploy_new → retire_old → contract, ensuring old traffic ceases before the note column is dropped.

stages.description: Add new customer_note column to account_user table alongside existing note column.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD COLUMN customer_note TEXT NULL;

stages.description: Copy existing note values into customer_note so new version can read them.
sql: UPDATE account_user SET customer_note = note WHERE customer_note IS NULL;

stages.description: Deploy the new code version that writes and reads customer_note.
Retire the old code version that only knows the note column; after retirement no writes to note occur.
Remove the old note column after old version is retired.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user DROP COLUMN note;
